fonts.display: 'Signifier', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Pitch', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Parchment Stone
palette.role: Primary page canvas — the warm stone-gray ground that replaces clinical white throughout the entire site

palette.name: Bone White
palette.role: Elevated card and section surface, one step lighter than the canvas

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Nav background, pill button fills, card surfaces needing maximum contrast against the stone canvas

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: Primary text, hairline borders, icon strokes — the dominant ink of the system

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Nav text, secondary text where pure black feels too heavy

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Muted body text, inactive states, dividers and borders at lower hierarchy

palette.name: Inkstone
palette.role: Deep surface for inverted sections and dark text on light cream backgrounds

palette.name: Oxblood
palette.role: Red accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis.

palette.name: Olive Khaki
palette.role: Secondary accent for borders and subdued interactive elements where oxblood would overpower

palette.name: Sage Stone
palette.role: Earthy neutral surface for product swatches and muted backgrounds — sits between canvas and accent

palette.name: Buttercream
palette.role: Soft champagne surface for the announcement bar and decorative letterform washes

palette.name: Pale Buttercream
palette.role: Lightest cream tint for subtle washes and hover states on yellow surfaces

palette.name: Cobalt Outline
palette.role: Outlined action border only — the one break in the earth-tone palette, used for ghost pill buttons that need to read as interactive without filling
